reason: The patch changes Update in pkg/apiserver/rest/dualwriter_mode3.go (patch lines 229-244). The background goroutine now calls d.Legacy.Update with the caller's raw objInfo, where it used to wrap the object unified storage returned in an updateWrapper. As a result, legacy re-runs objInfo.UpdatedObject against its own old object after Update has returned, and the result can differ from what unified storage stored. Mode2 still uses the wrapper (dualwriter_mode2.go:298).
